items.raw_excerpt: MELBOURNE, Sept 8 : Once an amateur club soccer field on the outskirts of Melbourne, the Monbulk Recreational Reserve's stretch of artificial turf is now an unlikely nursery for Australian teenagers with dreams of making the National Football League. Three days before the country stages its first regular-sea
items.summary_en: A suburban soccer field in Monbulk, on the outskirts of Melbourne, has been turned into a punting academy. Australian teenagers train there with hopes of reaching the National Football League in the United States. The academy is the only one of its kind in the country.

items.raw_excerpt: The annual Happy City Index, put together by a global team of researchers has released its 2026 results. Trondheim secured 6th place globally and came out on top among Norwegian cities. What sets it apart?F
items.summary_en: Trondheim ranked 6th in the 2026 Happy City Index by a global research team. It was the highest-ranked Norwegian city in the list. The index measures what makes cities joyful places to live.
items.summary_ko: 트론헤임이 글로벌 연구진이 발표한 2026년 행복 도시 지수에서 세계 6위에 올랐다. 노르웨이 도시 중에서는 1위를 차지했다. 이 지수는 도민들이 살기 좋은 도시를 만드는 요소들을 종합 평가한다.
items.title_en: Trondheim Named 6th Happiest City in the World

items.raw_excerpt: Renters normally have little say over what happens to electricity generated on the roof of their building. A housing project in Innsbruck is trying a different approach, with tenants able to use surplus solar power without paying for it.
items.summary_en: A social-housing project in Innsbruck, Austria lets tenants use extra solar power from their building's rooftop for free. Normally renters have no control over electricity generated on their roof. The Tyrol-based program aims to share clean energy benefits directly with residents.
items.summary_ko: 오스트리아 인스브루크의 한 공공주택 단지가 건물 옥상에서 생산되는 여분의 태양광 전기를 세입자들이 무료로 사용할 수 있게 했다. 보통 임차인들은 옥상에서 생산되는 전기와 관련해 아무런 결정권이 없다. 티롤 지역의 이 프로그램은 청정 에너지의 혜택을 주민들에게 직접 나누는 것을 목표로 하고 있다.
items.title_en: Austrian housing project gives tenants free rooftop solar electricity
items.title_ko: 오스트리아 주택 단지, 세입자에 옥상 태양광 전기 무료 제공
items.title_original: How some social-housing tenants in Tyrol are getting free solar electricity
